svg.title: Stroke index and handicap remainder
svg.desc: Diagram: SI 18 is hardest; spare shots from handicap remainder go to high SI first.
svg.text: " SI 18 = hardest hole on the card (first spare shot from the remainder).
" SI 1 = easiest hole (remainder shots allocated last).
Playing handicap: base = handicap ÷ 18 (full shots on every hole); remainder = handicap mod 18.
Each hole gets base shots, plus one extra on holes where SI e 19  remainder (when remainder > 0).
If handicap is a multiple of 18 (e.g. 18, 36), remainder is 0: every hole gets the same strokes; SI does not split a remainder.
Enter course SI to match your society scorecard under Admin ’ course edit.
